profile.name: ISEG高压电源模块
profile.description: 这是一种多通道高压电源模块，用于为实验中的探测器、光电倍增管等器件提供和监测稳定高压。设备支持通道管理、限压限流、斜坡速度、状态寄存器、事件寄存器以及温度和内部供电监测，常用于核物理、粒子探测和其他需要精密高压偏置的实验系统。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-channel high-voltage power supply module used to provide and monitor stable high voltage for laboratory devices such as detectors and photomultiplier tubes. It supports channel management, voltage and current limits, ramp speed settings, status and event registers, and monitoring of temperature and internal supply rails, making it suitable for nuclear physics, particle detection, and other experiments requiring precise HV biasing.
